reviewer: Claude source, predicate and witness review
scope: robolab StackYellowOnRedTask at the pinned revision; seed 0 witness only. Semantic projection of the official predicate, not physical qualification of other seeds or scenes.
task_language: Stack the yellow block on the red block

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read Terminations.success (stacked bottom_to_top), check_stacked, above_top/above_bottom and in_contact.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene toys_cleanup.usda with blocks, cubes, figurines, birdhouse and bin; only the red and yellow blocks matter.

assets_and_frames.basis: Stack test uses world-frame bounding boxes of the two blocks and their contact sensor.

success_timing.basis: Evaluated every control step; RoboLab freezes the episode at success and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: Both blocks are visible in the over-shoulder and wrist cameras.

success_witness.basis: Witness: yellow block dropped onto the red block with the robot held away gives the success termination on seed 0.

counterexamples.basis: Witness: yellow beside red and the reset state give false.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: stacked(objects=[red_block, yellow_block], order=bottom_to_top): yellow in contact with red and above its top (or bottom) face.
conditions.interpretation: Yellow block on top of the red block, touching it.

conditions.source_basis: Terminations.success uses stacked only; no gripper_detached term.
conditions.interpretation: The termination does not require releasing the yellow block.
conditions.omission_reason: A predicate weakness is documented for review, not delivered as an exploit; the instruction's intent (a stack) is unchanged.

public_clauses: The yellow block must end up on top of the red block, touching it.

counterexamples.case: Yellow block on the table beside the red block: false.

limitations: Witness covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout; source-derived negative cases marked as such were not executed.
